# User Preferences

## UI

The user prefers dark mode across all tools. They also want compact density in lists and sidebars — no large padded cards.

## Locale

Timezone is Asia/Kolkata (UTC+5:30). Preferred language for agent responses is English with concise tone. Date format should be YYYY-MM-DD.

## Editor

Cursor font size preference is 14. Tab size is 2 spaces. Autosave is enabled. The user dislikes Inter, Roboto, and Arial for branded frontend work.
